entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • .NET 8 - Unexpected float multiplication result after bit-shifting on Mono ARM64 linux-bionic #123336

  • .NET 10, 9, 8, 7, osx-arm64: AccessViolationException in a single-file compressed app #123324

Closed

  • [NAOT] GC hang on IReferenceTrackerHost_DisconnectUnusedReferenceSources with the built-in DispatcherQueueSynchronizationContext #123321
  • Add WaitHandle.Wait(Any/All) overloads with params WaitHandle[] argument #44178
  • The Enum type of F# cannot be passed through the Arguments parameter of TypeFilterAttribute #46705
  • CIL .data-Declaration: Address of label not working #47124
